description: Alert group gpu-fault-control-plane-capacity; every panel carries the thresholds and runbook anchors of the alerts it plots (see docs/管理员日常运维.md §8).

panels.description:
One series per scraped Pod across api-ha, control-worker and telemetry-spool-worker.

1 means the workflow detail gauges cover only the newest slice of the table.

In-flight Store calls over the per-process admission capacity. api-ha and control-worker run four uvicorn workers behind one port, so each scrape samples one of four processes.
